sections.title: How I Became a Game Developer
sections.text: My curiosity for games and technology started early. Over time that curiosity turned into learning programming and understanding how games are built. What began as an interest eventually became a career where I could combine creativity, technology, and problem solving to build interactive experiences.

sections.title: How Family & Friends Shaped Who I Am Today
sections.text: Support and encouragement from family and friends played an important role in shaping my journey. Their belief in curiosity, creativity and persistence helped me continue exploring technology and eventually pursue a career in the game industry.
